Llamada así por la frase portuguesa que significa "eco del bosque", la línea se basa en la intensidad del paisaje natural de Brasil y la cultura que dio forma al deporte.
items.description_en: The Eco da Selva collection was built for jiu-jitsu practitioners and competitors who expect performance in every detail while offering a bold, energetic look. Named after the Portuguese phrase for “echo of the forest,” the line draws from the intensity of Brazil’s natural landscape — and the culture that shaped the sport. The colors and patterns take cues from two iconic sources: the deep tones of the rainforest and the striking visuals of Brazilian soccer jerseys. Every piece — rash guards, shorts, spats, tees, and hoodies — is engineered for movement, durability, and purpose, while carrying a design that stands with confidence. Available in men’s, women’s and youth sizes and styles, the Eco da Selva line has the technology to optimize your performance and look good doing it. --------- The Eco da Selva Pro Grappling Short is built for both competition and daily training, offering an athletic fit that supports natural movement without extra bulk. With a mid-thigh cut and 5" inseam, these shorts strike the ideal balance between coverage and freedom — keeping you quick and agile during scrambles, transitions, and submissions. Constructed from lightweight, moisture-wicking fabric with flatlock stitching for reduced chafing and increased durability. The 2" comfort waistband features a low-profile interior drawstring, offering a secure fit that stays locked in through every roll. The unlined interior keeps the feel minimal for those who prefer to layer with compression shorts or Vale Tudo gear. Ready for customization, these shorts are designed to represent your team or personal style. Pair with the matching rash guard for a cohesive, competition-ready look. • Athletic fit – unlined, mid-thigh cut with 5" inseam • Lightweight, moisture-wicking fabric • Flatlock stitching for durability and comfort • 2" comfort waistband with interior drawstring • Sublimated design won’t crack or fad • Matches Eco da Selva rash guard • 92% polyester / 8% spandex

items.name: Emily Leyva Air Pro 3.0 Gi
items.description: Inspirado en Grit. Diseñado para la grandeza.
items.description_en: Inspired by Grit. Engineered for Greatness. The Emily Leyva Air Pro 3.0 Gi isn't just a piece of gear—it's a tribute to the relentless spirit of a rising star in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Emily Leyva has carved her name into the sport's elite, clinching titles like the 2025 IBJJF Pan Championship in the Purple Belt Light Featherweight division. Her journey is marked by unwavering determination. During the 2024 Brazilian Nationals, Emily dislocated her elbow mid-match but chose to continue fighting, embodying the very essence of resilience. When asked about the pain, her response was telling: she wasn't upset about the injury but about the mistake that cost her the win. This gi captures that same tenacity. Its design reflects Emily's agile and elusive fighting style, featuring curved jacket slits that make grips harder to maintain. The ultra-lightweight fabric ensures competitors can make weight without compromise, while the innovative pant closure system offers a customizable fit for peak performance. Wearing the Emily Leyva Air Pro 3.0 Gi means embracing a mindset where challenges are met with courage, and setbacks are just setups for comebacks. Key Features: - EVA-lined ripstop lapel for superior grip resistance - Reinforced stress points on jacket and pants for enhanced durability - Curved jacket vents for a streamlined, competition-ready fit - Nano pearl weave fabric minimizes shrinkage ( 1%) for consistent sizing - IBJJF-compliant for legal competition use - Lightweight, strategic materials: Jacket: 380 GSM, 90% cotton / 10% poly Pants: 270 GSM, 55% cotton / 45% poly
